summary: Argentinian live event brand Bresh has recorded its “best ever numbers” with its FIFA World Cup tour, as organisers tell IQ how targeting pre-curated audiences assembled around football matches helped them host 40,000 fans in 17 events across North America during the tournament. title: Tour news: Tyla goes global for the first time
summary: South African star Tyla has announced a 34-date global run with The A*Pop World Tour, spanning Europe, the UK, North America and Africa, marking the singer’s first global run. Coming in support of her sophomore album A*POP , the tour follows Tyla’s 2025 We Wanna Party Tour across Asia, which included sold-out performances in Japan and the UAE. The tour opens on 12 October in Paris’s Zenith (6,300-cap) and closes 9 January at Johannesburg’s Expo Centre Nasrec (20,000-cap).
